Exactly. A dead baby doesn’t help the mother with anything. So does a highly risky pregnancy that comes with little reward for the mother in the short and long term. If the mother’s life is on the line just by giving birth to that baby and there is little hope around ensuring both of them are safe: In many cases when the stakes are too high, abortion would be the only thing that could guarantee the mother’s life can be saved.

Let me be clear: I completely agree with you that in certain circumstances when it is NOT that bad, the mother and the baby should both be saved. But that does NOT apply to certain, extreme life-on-the-line situations where the mother giving birth to a baby would carry a real risk of killing her.

I’m saying the option of an abortion should be available under these dire circumstances. I’m not saying the baby shouldn’t be saved along with the mother IF IT IS POSSIBLE. The key nuance is if saving both of them are possible. In that case I would support both of them being saved.
